address: 141 Rui'an Street, Da'an District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: This trattoria entices diners indoors with its lively, uniquely Italian vibe and authentic Italian fare. Hand-rolled, thin-crust pizzas are crispy and tasty, from classics like Margherita to crowd-pleasers such as Tartufata. The chef learned his craft in Italy and his home-style pasta bears witness to his respect for tradition. The meat dishes are generous and great for sharing. Sensibly priced by-the-glass wine selection.
